meta.name: paper-orchestra
meta.description: Orchestrate the full PaperOrchestra (Song et al., 2026, arXiv:2604.05018) five-agent pipeline to turn unstructured research materials (idea, experimental log, LaTeX template, conference guidelines, optional figures) into a submission-ready LaTeX manuscript and compiled PDF. TRIGGER when the user asks to "write a paper from my experiments", "turn this idea and these results into a paper", "generate a conference submission", "run paper-orchestra on X", or otherwise wants the end-to-end paper-writing pipeline. Coordinates the outline-agent, plotting-agent, literature-review-agent, section-writing-agent, and content-refinement-agent skills.

copy.tagline: 将研究材料自动转化为可提交的 LaTeX 论文和 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有零散的研究笔记和实验结果，想快速生成一篇格式规范的学术论文。
